svg.title: Three thread models
svg.desc: Animation: three panels receive the same 1,000 requests, each waiting 200 milliseconds on I/O, on a machine with 8 cores. In Spring MVC on platform threads, blocks representing the 200 Tomcat threads fill up, all blocked in I/O, and a queue bar grows to 800 requests waiting for a thread. In WebFlux, 8 event-loop threads pulse while dots representing 1,000 pending I/O operations hold no thread, so nothing queues. In MVC with virtual threads, 8 carrier threads run 1,000 virtual threads; most dots are grey and unmounted while they wait, and a changing set of 8 is mounted. The numbers are illustrative.
svg.text: 1,000 requests in flight, each waiting 200 ms on I/O, 8 CPU cores. Illustrative.
Only the platform-thread pool makes requests queue. The database and upstreams are still the real limit.
